title: Write a product vision
summary: A product vision describes the future you want to create for users, typically three to five years out. It helps teams make good decisions without being told what to do.

beginner: Describe the users and the problem in their words.
Describe what their life looks like when the product succeeds.
Keep it short enough to remember.
Test it with your team and some users.
intermediate: Ground the vision in research about users and market trends.
Write it from the user's point of view, three to five years out.
Make it inspiring but believable, and test it with the team and leaders.
Use it to check whether roadmap items move you towards it.
experienced: Create a vision that connects several teams' work into one story.
Use a narrative or prototype of the future to make it concrete.
Keep the vision stable while letting strategy change.
Revisit it each year with fresh evidence.

canDelegateTo.task: Create a visual or prototype of the future experience
Supply research on user needs and trends

toolExamples.figma: Mock up a 'day in the life' of a user in the future.
toolExamples.claude: Ask it to challenge your vision: which assumptions would have to be true?

definitionOfDone: Vision written from the user's point of view
